On 2026-10-24 the blog was merged and Netlify returned HTTP 200 for the exact URL while the daily obligation remained GENERATED and commercial-day state degraded.
fix: Add a bounded, fail-closed exact PR-merge → production BG169 SHA ancestor → canonical article HTML → existing Supabase record_content_publication_state RPC → existing powerhouse_reconcile_terminal_publication_state RPC chain to the already scheduled hourly Powerhouse daily blog workflow. Never make a second scheduler, write directly to the table, or auto-publish a new candidate.
prevention_rule: Only existing reviewed merged same-date blog PR + production release.json with BG169 authority and GitHub verified merge ancestry + page HTML 200 with matching canonical and content-id can promote a GENERATED obligation to LIVE_PROVEN. On missing proof exit without mutation. The next scheduled run retries same lineage. No inferred traffic/revenue.
terminal_rule: Exact Required+CodeQL protected main merge, scheduled workflow readback and real next-date canonical publication closure. 2026-10-24 manual closure alone does not prove the new automation has executed.
